verdict.rationale: Apple's Mac User Guide has a dedicated switcher section that teaches 'how to find your way around the Mac' and how to transfer files from a PC. Setup Assistant and Migration Assistant guide a Windows switcher through initial setup and migration, so the desktop-learning half is documented and setup is guided. Missing for 10: any evidenced guided tutorial for installing or reinstalling the OS itself, detail on the depth of the interface tutorials beyond a one-line description, and independent or hands-on corroboration that switchers find the guides effective.
